# Unicode Other capture

Recorded from Claude Code 2.1.302 in a disposable background session. A freshly started installed dashboard answered its first two-option single-select question with `嗨`. `single-hi.raw` is the unmodified prefix of `claude logs` through the pasted answer, before Enter. `transcript.jsonl` retains the real question and answer record fields used by the replay.

`refused.raw` records two simultaneous dashboard inspections navigating a real two-question ask into an empty review. `refused.reason.txt` is the resulting attach error.
